sources.citation: Tsuchida, Shigeru. 1985. Kulon: Yet another Austronesian language in Taiwan? Bulletin of the Institute of Ethnology, Academia Sinica 60: 1-59 (issued Dec. 1986).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: The only primary source on Kulon: 45 words recorded by non-linguists (Ogawa 26 Jun 1905, informant female 64; Police Agency May 1917; 'Asai(?)' ca. 1937), presented as a comparative wordlist (pp. 3-7 sound correspondences, pp. 11-59 appendix). No phonology or accent section. Sole mention of stress is p. 3 fn. 1: recorders' pronunciation 'seems to have been uncertain in regard to the distinction between b/m, l/r, medial and final t/l/r, and stress/length.'
